# Weftora - Premium Home & Personal Textiles

> Weftora is a premier textile manufacturing and export brand located in the historic textile capital of Panipat, Haryana, India. We specialize in luxury, absorbent, and skin-gentle textiles crafted with care for infants, kids, women, and modern homes.

Managing Director: Aryan Pruthi

## Core Product Offerings

### 1. Kids Cotton Printed Towels
- **Primary Search Query:** kids cotton printed towels
- **Material Composition:** 100% Pure Combed Natural Cotton Terry
- **Dimensions:** Length 60 Inches (152 cm) × Breadth 30 Inches (76 cm)
- **Character Designs:** Spider-Man, Stitch, Bluey & Bingo, Minnie Mouse ("Smile")
- **Dye Quality:** Reactive non-toxic child-safe eco-friendly dyes, colorfast and fade-resistant across repeated high-temperature laundering.
- **Key Characteristics:** Generous full-body wrap size for kids aged 3 to 14 years. Highly absorbent plush terry cloth that wicks moisture in seconds without scratchy fibers or chemical finishes.
- **Target Audience:** Parents, nurseries, schools, swimming academies, gift buyers, wholesale retailers.
- **Direct Link:** https://weftora.com/#kids-cotton-towels

### 2. Baby Hooded Towels (Animal & Bear Collections)
- **Primary Search Query:** baby hooded towels
- **Series A: Baby Animal Hooded Towels (6 Colours):**
  - Available Shades: Purple, Pink, Grey, Beige, Mint Green, Blue
  - Design: Integrated corner hood with embroidered cute animal faces and soft contouring.
- **Series B: Bear Hooded Towels (5 Colours):**
  - Available Shades: Blue, Brown, Grey, Mint Green, Pink
  - Design: Cuddly 3D bear ears on corner hood, ultra-plush fluffy texture.
- **Material Composition:** Hypoallergenic, ultra-soft micro-terry and coral fleece, engineered specifically for delicate infant and toddler skin barrier protection.
- **Safety Profile:** Zero chemical irritants, lint-free, anti-chafing rounded seams.
- **Recommended Age:** Newborns (0 months) up to 36 months (toddlers).
- **Direct Link:** https://weftora.com/#baby-hooded-towels

### 3. Ladies Hair Cap & Quick-Dry Hair Towels
- **Primary Search Query:** ladies hair cap
- **Material Composition:** Advanced high-tech micro-absorbent anti-frizz waffle & loop weave.
- **Closure Mechanism:** Ergonomic tapered cone shape with rear fastening button and high-tension elastic loop for a slip-free, hands-free fit.
- **Colour Palette & Embroidery (6 Shades):**
  - Coral Pink (Floral Accent embroidery)
  - Maroon (Rainbow Star embroidery)
  - Raspberry (Sweet Berry embroidery)
  - Blue (Crescent Moon embroidery)
  - Orange (So Cool Citrus embroidery)
  - Brown (Cute Pup embroidery)
- **Hair Health Benefits:** Reduces blow-drying heat exposure by up to 50%, protects delicate hair cuticles from rough towel friction, eliminates split ends and morning frizz, allows seamless simultaneous makeup or skincare application.
- **Direct Link:** https://weftora.com/#ladies-hair-cap

## Wholesale, Bulk Orders & OEM Private Label Manufacturing
Weftora is a direct manufacturer based in Panipat, Haryana, offering factory-direct pricing, private labeling, OEM manufacturing, and wholesale bulk supplies across India and internationally.

- **Minimum Order Quantities (MOQs):**
  - Trial / Starter Batch: 50 – 100 pcs
  - Wholesale Standard: 100 – 500 pcs
  - Master Distributor / Bulk Lots: 500 – 2,000+ pcs
  - Export Container Loads: 5,000+ pcs
- **OEM & Private Label Services:** Custom woven brand tags, barcode labeling, custom GSM weights, bespoke embroidery, and branded retail polybags.
- **Taxation & Compliance:** GST compliant invoices, HSN Code 6302 (Toilet linen and kitchen linen of terry towelling or similar terry fabrics, of cotton).
- **Logistics & Dispatch:** Ready-stock dispatch within 24–48 hours from Panipat hub via Safexpress, V-Trans, Delhivery, and local transport. 24h transit to Delhi NCR; 2–4 days to Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, and major Indian commercial hubs.
- **Sample Kits:** Physical product sample kits available on request for verified retail stores, boutique chains, and institutional buyers.
- **Direct Wholesale Contacts:**

  - WhatsApp / Phone: +91 9817660065, +91 7404970065
